## PRB1.7. Investments {#prb1.7.-investments .Heading-2-ER}

- DCAC Cyprus planned a total asset value for new investments in RP4 of 40.2M€2022, of which 73.4% relates to new major investments. DCAC Cyprus planned 4 new major investments for RP4, of which 3 have started and 1 has not yet started.

- In 2025, DCAC Cyprus overspent +0.3M€2022 (+248.2%) in costs related to new major investments. The NSA noted that some investments are ahead of schedule.

- According to the reporting tables, DCAC Cyprus underspent -0.3M€2022 (-4.9%) in costs related to investments in 2025. These amounts must be reimbursed to the airspace users through a reduction of future unit rate(s), unless the NSA decides after consultation with the users, that the ANSP must not reimburse a part of the difference according to article 28 of Regulation (EU) 2019/317.

- DCAC Cyprus reported no funding from Union assistance programmes in 2025.
